kultivator.gabung.hidup.bukan_anggota: You are not a member of this sect.
kultivator.gabung.hidup.sapa.kakak: Senior, thank you for your hard work.
kultivator.gabung.penjaga.datang: Disciples of %s come to help you (%s of them)!
kultivator.gabung.misi.lapor: Return to the Mission Board to report
kultivator.gabung.misi.tujuan.bunuh_kema: Clear the camp at the mark
kultivator.gabung.misi.tujuan.serah: Bring %2$s of the requested goods to the Mission Board
kultivator.gabung.misi.tujuan.kebun: Harvest the herb plots (sneak at a plot): %1$s/%2$s
kultivator.gabung.misi.alasan.ranah: Your realm is not high enough for a mission of this rank.
kultivator.gabung.misi.alasan.harian: Today's mission limit (%s) is used up.
kultivator.gabung.misi.alasan.hilang: That mission is no longer on the board.
kultivator.gabung.misi.alasan.jauh: You must be within %s blocks of a group member or of the board.
kultivator.gabung.misi.antar_tiba: The parcel reached %s. They will remember our sect kindly.
kultivator.gabung.misi.kebun_panen: Harvest %s/%s. The medicinal leaves smell bitter and fresh.
kultivator.gabung.misi.kebun_tunggu: This plot was just harvested. Try again in about %s minutes.
kultivator.gabung.misi.kelompok_kurang: The group has %s; it needs %s before the lair master shows itself.
kultivator.gabung.misi.tujuan_selesai: The goal of %s is done. Return to the Mission Board to report.
kultivator.gabung.misi.buru.teks.lurus.0: The farmers at the foot of the mountain complain that monsters come down at dusk and trample the fields. Defeat %2$s monsters around the mark, so they know this sect still guards them.
kultivator.gabung.misi.buru.teks.lurus.1: The Outer Elder taps the map: 'Monsters have gathered there since the new moon. Clear %2$s of them before they dare come near the gate.'
Monster hides and cores sell well at the sect market. Defeat %2$s monsters around the mark; half the gain feeds the kitchen, half fills your own hands.
A merchant pays the sect for a safe road. Defeat %2$s monsters around the mark and that road will be busy again.
kultivator.gabung.misi.buru.teks.iblis.0: The training pool wants monster blood. Defeat %2$s around the mark. The weak become fertiliser, the strong a lesson.
kultivator.gabung.misi.buru.teks.iblis.1: Those monsters hunt our land without leave. Slaughter %2$s and let the rest understand who owns this mountain.
Rogue cultivators made camp and rob pilgrims. Break up the camp at the mark; defeat them, but stain your hands no more than you must.
The smoke of a rogue camp can be seen from the bell tower. Go, and make them understand that this land is guarded.
kultivator.gabung.misi.kemah.teks.netral: The rogue camp at the mark taxes caravans that should be paying us. Drive them off.
They call themselves wanderers; they are thieves. Clear the camp at the mark; you may keep the spoils.
The rogue camp at the mark pays us nothing. Show them the price of an insult.
A pack of stray dogs camps on our land. Beat them; those who yield may crawl home.
The Medicine Elder has run out of ingredients for the disciples' healing pills. Bring %2$s spirit herbs at least %3$s years old to the Mission Board.
'Old herbs keep the patience of the mountain,' says the Medicine Elder. Find %2$s stalks at least %3$s years old.
kultivator.gabung.misi.herba.teks.netral: Pill orders from the towns are piling up. The pavilion needs %2$s spirit herbs at least %3$s years old, quickly.
Herbs of %3$s years and more are prized by the sect's furnaces. Bring %2$s stalks and your name will be noted.
The poison pool must be fed. Bring %2$s spirit herbs at least %3$s years old; do not ask what for.
Our blood brew wants old roots. %2$s herbs at least %3$s years old, or do not come back empty-handed.
A young disciple must visit his mother in the nearest town. Walk with him to the gate of the marked town.
The sect's letter to the Sect Office in town must arrive safely. Take it to the marked town.
kultivator.gabung.misi.kawal.teks.netral: A regular merchant of the sect asks for an escort to town. Take him to the mark and ask few questions.
The pavilion's consignment must reach the marked town before the market closes.
A 'guest' of the sect must reach town without many witnesses. Take him to the mark.
Take this sealed box to the town at the mark. If anyone peeks, you know what to do.
kultivator.gabung.misi.binatang.teks.lur: A spirit beast rages near its lair and has hurt woodcutters. Defeat it at the mark before someone dies.
An old spirit beast has come down from its lair. End its rampage; its core will help a sick disciple.
kultivator.gabung.misi.binatang.teks.net: The pavilion ordered the core of the spirit beast at the mark. Defeat it and bring home your victory.
The Treasury Elder wants the fur and core of the spirit beast at the mark. Do not let it get away.
kultivator.gabung.misi.binatang.teks.ibl: The spirit beast at the mark is strong and wild. Break it; only the stronger bow to us.
The blood of the spirit beast at the mark will strengthen the blood pool. Defeat it.
kultivator.gabung.misi.sarang.teks.lurus: The monster nest at the mark is breeding. Defeat %2$s marked monsters before they raid the village.
The stench of the cave at the mark reaches the herb garden. Clear out %2$s of its dwellers.
kultivator.gabung.misi.sarang.teks.netra: The nest at the mark blocks the spirit mine's path. Defeat %2$s marked monsters.
The monsters at the mark have begun troubling caravans. %2$s of them must go.
kultivator.gabung.misi.sarang.teks.iblis: The nest at the mark smells of something we like: power. Take it by beating %2$s of its dwellers.
The monster nest at the mark defies us. Slaughter %2$s of them.
Bandits waylay pilgrims on the mountain road. Go to their camp at the mark and stop them.
A widow lost her buffalo to the bandits at the mark. Restore justice.
kultivator.gabung.misi.begal.teks.netral: The bandits at the mark seized goods the sect paid for. Take back our pride.
The bandits at the mark forgot whose roads these are. Remind them.
The bandits at the mark rob without our leave. Take their loot, and the lives of those who resist.
You want to learn? The bandit camp at the mark is a fine teacher.
kultivator.gabung.misi.kafilah.teks.luru: A medicine caravan rests at the mark. Guard it for %2$s seconds until it is ready to leave.
A salt caravan has stopped at the mark and bandits are watching. Stand guard for %2$s seconds.
kultivator.gabung.misi.kafilah.teks.netr: The sect's caravan carries spirit silk. Guard its stop at the mark for %2$s seconds.
The caravan pays the sect for protection. Stand at the mark for %2$s seconds; do not fall asleep.
kultivator.gabung.misi.kafilah.teks.ibli: A caravan that 'borrows' our road is guarded until its tribute is paid: %2$s seconds at the mark.
Guard the caravan at the mark for %2$s seconds. If anyone runs off with the load, give chase.
kultivator.gabung.misi.gua.teks.lurus.0: The cave at the mark is said to hold an ancestor's inscription. Search it and stay there %2$s seconds.
kultivator.gabung.misi.gua.teks.lurus.1: A disciple went missing near the cave at the mark. Search that cave for %2$s seconds.
kultivator.gabung.misi.gua.teks.netral.0: The cave at the mark has a spirit vein. Map it and stay %2$s seconds to record it.
kultivator.gabung.misi.gua.teks.netral.1: The Treasury Elder wants to know whether the cave at the mark is worth mining. Survey it for %2$s seconds.
kultivator.gabung.misi.gua.teks.iblis.0: Something hides in the cave at the mark. Go in for %2$s seconds and come back alive.
kultivator.gabung.misi.gua.teks.iblis.1: The cave at the mark was once an old demon's retreat. Look for his traces for %2$s seconds.
The headman of the village at the mark wrote asking for a healer. Bring him the Medicine Elder's answer.
The sect gives spirit rice seed to the village at the mark. Deliver it.
kultivator.gabung.misi.kurir.teks.netral: The sect's bill must reach the village at the mark.
The village at the mark ordered monster-warding talismans. Deliver them.
The village at the mark has not paid its tribute. Bring this letter and let them read it in front of you.
Carry a message to the village at the mark: our sect is watching.
kultivator.gabung.misi.tawanan.teks.luru: One of our disciples is held by rogue cultivators at the mark. Free him.
Rogue cultivators at the mark hold a wandering healer. Free her.
kultivator.gabung.misi.tawanan.teks.netr: A regular merchant of the sect is held at the mark. Free him; he owes us.
The camp at the mark holds a town scribe. Release him and the sect will be paid.
kultivator.gabung.misi.tawanan.teks.ibli: The captive in the marked camp is ours, not theirs. Take him back.
They hold one of ours at the mark. Nobody takes what belongs to this sect.
kultivator.gabung.misi.gabung_kebun.teks: The sect's herb garden was newly planted. Harvest its plots %2$s times within two days, patient as young Han Li in his master's garden.
The Medicine Elder is away. Keep his garden: harvest %2$s times and do not let the leaves wilt.
The herb garden must be harvested %2$s times within two days. Do it neatly.
Medicinal leaves are best picked at the right time. Harvest %2$s times with pauses between.
The poison garden does not tend itself. Harvest %2$s times; mind the purple thorns.
The last servant who kept this garden died of poison. Harvest %2$s times, and do not be careless.
kultivator.gabung.misi.gabung_antar.teks: The Sect Master sends a box of spirit tea to %1$s as a token of friendship. Deliver it to their gate.
A borrowed scroll must go back to %1$s. Do not let it get wet.
The trade contract with %1$s needs their seal. Take it to their gate.
There is a birthday gift for an elder of %1$s. Deliver it politely.
Our sect and %1$s are 'friends'. Take this box to their gate, and do not open it.
Deliver this letter to %1$s. It is a threat wrapped in good manners.
kultivator.gabung.misi.gabung_pesanan.te: The Merit Pavilion is short of stock. Bring %2$s pills (in a body sect: forged artifacts) of grade %3$s or better to the Mission Board.
Wounded disciples need pills. Make %2$s of grade %3$s or better and hand them in at the board.
An order from town: %2$s handmade goods of grade %3$s or better. Paid in PK.
The Pavilion Elder wants to test your hands: %2$s goods of grade %3$s or better.
The blood pool needs strengthening pills. %2$s of them, grade %3$s or better.
Bring %2$s of your own make, grade %3$s or better. Failures go down the ravine with their makers. A joke.
kultivator.gabung.misi.gabung_buru_iblis: A squad of demonic cultivators camps at the mark, close to our land. Destroy that camp before they take villagers.
The smell of blood comes from the camp at the mark; demonic cultivators are holding a rite. Stop it.
A squad of demonic cultivators camps at the mark. Drive them off the trade road.
The demonic cultivators' camp at the mark frightens the villages. Break it up.
Rivals camp at the mark and use our name. Destroy them.
The camp at the mark is what is left of a sect we beat long ago. Finish the job.
kultivator.gabung.misi.gabung_culik.teks: The rival camp at the mark holds an expert we wish to invite. Free him.
A formation expert is held in the rival camp at the mark. Bring him back.
The rival camp at the mark holds an expert we wish to invite. Bring him back.
A formation expert is stuck in the rival camp at the mark. Bring him home.
The rival camp at the mark holds someone our sect has 'invited'. Fetch that guest; clear the camp first.
A formation expert stays at the rival camp at the mark. Our sect wants him as its guest. Persuade the camp.
Rumour says %1$s is preparing an attack. Get close to their gate, watch for %2$s seconds unseen, then come back.
The Outer Elder needs eyes near %1$s. Hide near their gate for %2$s seconds.
%1$s is gathering weapons. Count their banners from the shadows for %2$s seconds.
Find out whether %1$s really takes more disciples. Watch their gate for %2$s seconds unnoticed.
That sanctimonious %1$s hides something. Watch its gate for %2$s seconds.
Learn the watch changes of %1$s. %2$s seconds in the shadows, then come home with news.
kultivator.gabung.misi.gabung_kelompok.t: A beast king woke in the lair at the mark. Set out with 2-4 fellow disciples and defeat it.
Going alone is arrogance. Form a group of 2-4, then subdue the master of the lair at the mark.
The giant beast at the mark is too strong for one disciple. Gather 2-4 people.
Great reward, great danger. A group of 2-4, the lair at the mark.
The master of the lair at the mark is worthy of sacrifice. Bring 2-4 people; the weak are bait.
Strength shared, victory shared. A group of 2-4 to the lair at the mark.
kultivator.gabung.misi.gabung_langit.tek: The sect's cloud palace needs a formation warden. Go up and keep watch on the disciples' terrace for %2$s seconds.
The elders meditate in the cloud palace. Keep its terrace quiet for %2$s seconds.
The cloud palace's formation needs fresh Qi. Stand on the terrace for %2$s seconds.
The cloud pier needs a record keeper. Serve %2$s seconds in the palace.
Our cloud palace floats above them all. Guard its terrace for %2$s seconds.
Only the strong may stand in the cloud palace. Prove it by keeping watch for %2$s seconds.
kultivator.gabung.tugas.pikul_air.teks: Eight trips from the well to the barrel with the yoke buckets. Wang Lin carried water for years before anyone noticed him.
kultivator.gabung.tugas.pikul_air.mulai: Fill the buckets at the well, empty them in the barrel. 8 times.
kultivator.gabung.tugas.sapu.teks: The courtyard must be clean before the elders pass. They say an old sweeper once swept his way to the Dao.
kultivator.gabung.tugas.kebun.teks: Water and weed four herb plots. Medicine grows out of patience.
kultivator.gabung.tugas.kebun.mulai: Sneak 3 seconds at each marked plot.
kultivator.gabung.tugas.tungku.teks: The alchemy furnace must not go out. When the fire sinks, fan it with the bamboo fan. Bai Xiaochun spent his nights like this.
kultivator.gabung.tugas.tungku.mulai: When smoke rises, sneak to fan it. 12 of 20.
kultivator.gabung.tugas.kitab.teks: Copy five characters of the Thousand Character Classic in the right order. A calm hand writes a calm Dao.
kultivator.gabung.tugas.kitab.mulai: Remember the order, then pick the characters one by one.
kultivator.gabung.tugas.kandang.teks: The spirit beasts of the sect pen are hungry. Feed three of them; if the pen is empty, fill three troughs.
kultivator.gabung.tugas.kandang.mulai: Use on the animals of the pen (or sneak at the troughs).
kultivator.gabung.tugas.pagi.teks: The morning drill on the ground with the disciples: horse stance, crane leaps, the turning step.
kultivator.gabung.tugas.pagi.mulai: Follow the eldest senior's three moves.
kultivator.gabung.tugas.jaga.teks: Keep the post from dusk to midnight. Sometimes a scout of an enemy sect tries to slip past.
kultivator.gabung.tugas.jaga.mulai: Hold the guard post for 120 seconds.
kultivator.gabung.tugas.pikul_air.isi: Buckets full. Carry them to the barrel (%s/%s).
kultivator.gabung.tugas.tungku.kipas: The fire is sinking! Fan it now (sneak).
kultivator.gabung.tugas.kitab.ingat: Memorise the order of these characters
kultivator.gabung.tugas.kitab.salah: A wrong stroke! One more and the paper is ruined.
kultivator.gabung.tugas.pagi.dekat: Go back to the training ground.
kultivator.gabung.tugas.pagi.gerak.0: Horse stance: sneak still for 4 seconds
kultivator.gabung.tugas.pagi.gerak.2: Turning Step: turn one full circle
kultivator.gabung.tugas.jaga.dekat: Go back to the guard post.
kultivator.gabung.tugas.jaga.pengintai: A shadow behind the fence. A scout! Beat him.
kultivator.gabung.tugas.alasan.sedang: You are already doing another duty.
kultivator.gabung.tugas.alasan.sudah: You already did this duty today.
kultivator.gabung.tugas.alasan.jam.pagi: The morning drill is only from 06:00 to 08:00.
kultivator.gabung.tugas.alasan.jam.jaga: The night watch runs from 18:00 to midnight.
kultivator.gabung.tugas.alasan.luar_komp: Daily duties are done in your own sect's compound.
kultivator.gabung.tugas.alasan.titik: This compound has no place for that duty.
kultivator.gabung.tugas.khas: The %s style values this duty more.
kultivator.gabung.tugas.lalai: The Outer Elder writes down your name: yesterday you did no daily duty. (Violation +1)
kultivator.gabung.tugas.chat.wajib: Servant and Registered Disciples must do one duty today.
kultivator.gabung.paviliun.syarat_anggot: Only members of the sect may exchange PK here.
kultivator.gabung.paviliun.alasan.pelaya: Servant Disciples may only take orders.
kultivator.gabung.paviliun.alasan.kelas: This sect is not great enough to keep that ware.
kultivator.gabung.paviliun.alasan.mutu: Your rank has no right to a technique of this grade yet.
kultivator.gabung.paviliun.alasan.warisa: You already hold the Heritage Technique.
kultivator.gabung.paviliun.alasan.tidak_: The pavilion has no such ware.
kultivator.gabung.paviliun.alasan.pesana: You need %s matching goods in your bag.
kultivator.gabung.paviliun.alasan.sumban: Today's limit of orders and donations (%s PK) is reached.
kultivator.gabung.paviliun.ceramah.sudah: This disciple already heard a sermon today.
kultivator.gabung.paviliun.ceramah.bukan: That disciple is not registered as a ward.
kultivator.gabung.paviliun.ceramah.seles: %s listens to the scripture sermon in earnest (+%s comprehension).
kultivator.gabung.jatah.ambil_dua: Two weeks of allowance: +%s PK and %s.
kultivator.gabung.jatah.belum: The next allowance is in %s days.
kultivator.gabung.jatah.siap: Your weekly allowance at %s waits at the Merit Pavilion.
kultivator.gabung.jatah.tempat: The allowance is collected at your sect's Merit Pavilion.
kultivator.gabung.kuota.terima: Secret realm quota: you receive %s from %s.
kultivator.gabung.kuota.umum: %s shares out its secret realm quota: %s keys given, %s for sale at the Merit Pavilion.
kultivator.gabung.kuota.pesaing: %s also got a quota. You may meet inside.
kultivator.gabung.kuota.lapor_bisa: You are back from the secret realm. Within %s days you may report to the Merit Pavilion (/kultivasi gabung lapor).
kultivator.gabung.kuota.lapor_jauh: Reports are handed in at the Merit Pavilion.
kultivator.gabung.kuota.lapor_setor: Realm report accepted and %s handed over: +%s PK.
kultivator.cerita.quest.gabung_tugas_per: The eldest senior hands you a bucket and a broom. 'Every great disciple started here,' he says, and leaves before you can ask anything.
Carry water from the well to the herb garden barrel (duty Carry Water).
Sweep the courtyard before the elders pass (duty Sweep the Courtyard).
Finish three more daily duties within five days.
You slacked. Do at least one daily duty to mend your name.
The Outer Elder gives you a small nod as he passes in the courtyard. Only a nod, but the other disciples saw it, and from that day they call you by your name, not 'the new servant'.
The Outer Elder sighs. 'Late is better than never.' Your name stays on the list, if with a small mark beside it.
kultivator.cerita.quest.gabung_tugas_air: The yoke buckets are heavy and the rope chafes your shoulders. The eldest senior laughs: 'A shoulder that never blistered will never carry a mountain.'
Carry water three more times, on different days.
Carry water three more times. Your shoulders are getting used to it.
One morning you notice the buckets feel light. It is not the buckets that changed. Someone who watched quietly from the veranda smiles and says nothing.
kultivator.cerita.quest.gabung_tugas_tun: The Fire That Must Not Die
The Medicine Elder leaves you his furnace with a yawn. 'If the fire dies, a whole night of pills turns to charcoal. Don't fall asleep.'
Keep the furnace two more times (duty Fan the Furnace).
The Medicine Elder wants fresh herbs for the next pills: do the duty Tend the Garden.
The pills whose fire you kept come out of the furnace with a golden ring. The Medicine Elder forgets your name again, but remembers your hands: 'That disciple who fans so patiently.'
kultivator.cerita.quest.gabung_tugas_kit: The Pavilion Elder blows the dust off a scroll. 'A scripture nobody copies dies with its paper. Copy it, and you will live on inside it.'
Copy the scripture two more times (duty Copy the Scripture).
The Pavilion Elder wants to see your learning put to use: finish one mission from the Sect Mission Board within six days.
The mission is not done. Copy one more scripture to make up for the Elder's time.
The Pavilion Elder writes your name in the margin of the lending book, a place usually kept for inner disciples. 'Scriptures are read to be used,' he says. 'You understand that.'
The Pavilion Elder takes your copy without many words. There is a little less dust on the shelves, and a little less disappointment.
kultivator.cerita.quest.gabung_tugas_kan: The Crane Chick in the Pen
In the sect pen there is a spirit crane chick that will not eat since its mother died. The Treasury Elder only says: 'You try.'
Feed the beasts of the pen two more times.
Come once more; the crane chick has begun to wait for you.
The crane chick finally pecks grain from your hand. The Treasury Elder pretends not to see, but the next day the pen's feed is increased, and your name is written on the pen's board.
kultivator.cerita.quest.gabung_tugas_pag: Every dawn the disciples line up on the ground. Latecomers stand at the very back, right in front of the rival who likes to laugh.
Join the morning drill two more times.
Once more, and this time stand in the front line.
That morning the eldest senior has you lead the count. Your voice shakes at first, then holds. The rival is silent the whole drill, which to you is the highest praise.
kultivator.cerita.quest.gabung_tugas_jag: The Discipline Elder gives you a lantern and a whistle. 'Night watch is boring,' he says, 'until one night it is not.'
Keep the night watch two more times.
There are strange footprints by the fence. Keep watch once more and pay attention.

The footprints belonged to another sect's scout, who no longer dares come back. The Discipline Elder writes one line in the watch book: 'Safe, because of this one.' It is the longest sentence he ever wrote about a disciple.
kultivator.gabung.tugas.gerbang.teks: Five minutes on guard at the compound gate. The gate is the sect's face: whoever passes judges us by the disciple standing there.
kultivator.gabung.tugas.gerbang.mulai: Stand 5 minutes at the compound gate.
kultivator.gabung.tugas.gerbang.dekat: Go back to the compound gate.
kultivator.gabung.tugas.mengajar.teks: An elder gives a lecture in the main hall. The disciples gather and listen to two minutes of wisdom.
kultivator.gabung.tugas.mengajar.mulai: Stand in the hall for 120 seconds. The disciples come to listen.
kultivator.gabung.tugas.mengajar.dekat: Go back to the hall; the disciples are waiting.
kultivator.gabung.tugas.mengajar.baris.0: Cultivation is rowing against the current. Stop rowing and you drift back.
kultivator.gabung.tugas.mengajar.baris.1: Qi follows intent, intent follows the heart. Set your heart in order before you touch your Qi.
kultivator.gabung.tugas.mengajar.baris.2: A sharp sword stays in its sheath. Ripe strength has no need to show itself.
kultivator.gabung.tugas.mengajar.baris.3: A thousand short steps go further than one leap that makes you fall.
kultivator.gabung.tugas.mengajar.baris.4: The mountain does not ask when it will be tall. It only stands still and takes the rain.
kultivator.gabung.tugas.mengajar.baris.5: Remember: this sect stands on the backs of those who carried water before you.
kultivator.gabung.paviliun.sumbang.tempa: Donations are taken at your sect's Merit Pavilion.
kultivator.gabung.paviliun.sumbang.tolak: The Pavilion Elder shakes his head: the Mission Office does not value what you hold (spirit stones go to the sect treasury, not to PK).
kultivator.gabung.paviliun.sumbang.sedik: Its value is too small to record.
kultivator.gabung.paviliun.sumbang.nilai: The Pavilion Elder holds his breath. 'Goods like these rarely reach our table.'
The Pavilion Elder nods, pleased. 'Good quality.'
The Pavilion Elder notes it down. 'Useful to the sect.'
The Pavilion Elder weighs it briefly. 'Little by little a hill is made.'
